Hi Eleanor — thanks for the note and for flagging the timing. Sorry to hear you hit scheduling friction. We can do this; two practical paths depending on how you want to handle procurement:  

Option A — Timebox extension (fastest)
- Add 3 calendar weeks to the existing pilot at the current pilot rate. No new PO required if you approve the amendment we generate.
- We can waive the standard change fee for this one-time extension.

Option B — Credit swap (preferred if you want no additional spend)
- We convert any unused portion of the original 30‑day allocation into a Redwood credit and apply it to the extension. Accounting treats this as a credit voucher (not a cash refund).
- Credit validity: 90 days from issue.

I can also offer a one-time 15% pilot-extension discount on the per-token rate if Skyline commits to a 6‑month Dedicated contract within 30 days of the extension end date. That would be a price lock and helps us schedule capacity for your workload.

Next steps: tell me which option you prefer and I will loop in Priya to confirm any capacity/throughput changes and Ben for the credit/voucher paperwork. If helpful I can sketch an amendment and circulate for quick sign-off.

—Mina

- Increase concurrency cap from 8 -> 12 for the extension window (temporary).

Hi Eleanor — Ben on finance here. Quick clarification on the credit mechanics so expectations are aligned:  

- We do not issue cash refunds for pilot usage. We can issue a credit voucher equal to the monetary value of any documented, unused allocation from the original 30‑day pilot.
- Credit vouchers can be applied to new invoices (extension amendment) and will appear as a line item reducing the balance due. Credits are valid for 90 days.
- As Mina noted, we can also offer a one‑time 15% discount if Skyline signs a 6‑month Dedicated commitment; that discount will be applied to the per-token rate in the contract.

Please confirm the unused amount (or we can calculate it from the attached usage CSV). If you prefer, I can create a draft credit memo and a DocuSign amendment for the extension — just tell me the option and the PO number to reference.
